# Version 4.152.2
> **GPU failures and Windows compatibility** · Released September 21, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.202/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.2 improves Ganesh failure handling and removes a Windows HarfBuzz compliance blocker.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Flush and buffer upload failures** — Propagates native task and submission failures and rejects draws whose GPU buffers failed to upload, reducing stale-data reuse under memory pressure. Managed flush operations remain void; this update exposes no new failure-result API. ([#5069](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5069), [#5117](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5117))
- **Windows HarfBuzz passes BA2007** — Removes command-line truncation-warning suppression from libHarfBuzzSharp so dependent applications no longer need a BinSkim BA2007 baseline for that DLL. Other reported BinSkim warnings are unchanged. ([#5121](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5121))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.202

The Windows native DLL now passes BinSkim BA2007 without changing its exported ABI or the bundled HarfBuzz version. Other existing BinSkim warnings are unchanged.
